explanation: Russian inventor Leon Theremin built his around 1920, played by moving the hands near two antennas without touching it. Robert Moog, who began by building theremins, showed his first synthesizers in 1964.

claims.text: Leon Theremin invented the theremin around 1920.
Robert Moog introduced his first synthesizers in 1964.
The theremin is played by moving the hands near two antennas, without touching it.
Robert Moog built theremins before he built synthesizers.

Volatility: evergreen; no time words, and nothing depends on knowledge newer than mid-2026. Regional: both instruments are known through films and pop records worldwide. Style: Oxford spelling, straight quotes, no en or em dashes, explanation within 35 words. Myths: screened against myths.json, no hit. Mystery: not applicable to a practice item.
